title: Neutralization of Tainted Grid Zones
statement:
An environmental scan grid of size R x C contains radiation readings. If a cell contains a reading of 0 (tainted zone), its entire row and its entire column become neutralized and reset to 0.

Given an R x C matrix, neutralize all affected rows and columns and print the final matrix.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers R and C.
Next R lines: C space-separated integers.
outputFormat: Print the modified R x C matrix.

sampleCases.explanation: Center cell 0 sets middle row and column to 0.
Corner zeros neutralize outer rows and columns.
